title: When the Uniform Breaks
author: Jonah Delacroix
blurb: Lena Underhill, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
